run_preprocess_i2b2_2010_ner: run the i2b2 2010 NER preprocessing script with beth, partners, test, and task directory arguments
process_concept: parse an i2b2 concept annotation string into a dictionary with type, span, and concept fields
build_label_vocab: build a BIO label vocabulary from concept annotation files across multiple dataset directories
reformatter: reformat clinical text and concept files into BIO-labeled token sequences for NER training
review_main: review the main preprocessing pipeline that splits datasets into train, dev, and test splits
